sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The RB-TB key (RB-TB) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the Federal State Reserve Agency base first barracks' underground shooting range.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Reserve
sections.text: - On the train station lower roof, on the left side of the sleeping bag next to the sand bags.

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: East barracks, In the basement of the east building marked with a black pawn near the parked helicopter on Reserve map. In the south section of the basement, the grated door is on the east side of the hallway. (Highlighted in green)

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- 3 Weapon racks (AK-74N, AKS-74U, AKS-74N, AKS-74UB, AKS-74UN)
- Loose loot (Weapon mods, Ammunition)
